messages:
leah (Marketing): Heads-up 9: we need final status page copy + embargoed email variant and a short social blurb. Want to gate public tweet until Monitoring. Can someone propose copy variants? @tom @rachel

tom (SRE): Incident summary: intermittent inference errors for a subset of customers starting 11:22 UTC. Auto-roll back to previous config at 11:46; service steady at 11:53. Investigating cause of autoscaler misconfiguration; monitoring continues.

rachel (Support): I'll assemble the impacted-account CSV and list of example request IDs. ETA 15m. Please confirm the phrasing we want in the email so support can triage inbound tickets.

leah (Marketing): Draft variants below. Short thread-only copy for status page and a slightly longer email paragraph. Pick one variant and any tweaks. React :thumbsup: for Variant 1, :eyes: for Variant 2, :rocket: for Variant 3.

Variant 1 (direct):
```
We experienced intermittent inference errors affecting a subset of requests between 11:221:53 UTC. We rolled back a recent config change; systems are stable and we are monitoring. Follow-up report to be published within 72 hours.
```

Variant 2 (reassuring):
```
A limited set of API requests experienced errors from 11:221:53 UTC due to a configuration change. We reverted the change and services are healthy. We are validating metrics and will share a detailed incident report within 72 hours.
```

Variant 3 (action oriented):
```
Intermittent errors impacted a subset of requests from 11:221:53 UTC. We reverted the change and recommend customers retry failed requests. We are monitoring and will publish a post-incident report in 72 hours.
```

priya (Legal): Avoid implying data impact. Use: "We have no evidence of customer data exposure at this time." only if SRE confirms after logs review. Otherwise use "We have no indication of data exposure."

dan (Growth): For email subject lines I suggest: "Redwood update: brief service interruption resolved" or "Service notice: interruption resolved, actions you can take". Also recommend we add an FAQ snippet to the email about retries.

leah (Marketing): Draft email excerpt (holds):
```
Subject: Redwood service update 1: intermittent errors resolved

Hi there,
Between 11:22 and 11:53 UTC, a configuration change caused intermittent errors for some requests to the Redwood API. We reverted the change and services are stable. If you saw errors, please retry the request; if issues persist, reply to this email or open a support ticket with request IDs.
We are continuing validation and will publish a full incident report within 72 hours.
```

rachel (Support): Good. Please wait to send until I confirm impacted-account list. Also include support escalation contacts for high-priority customers. I'll upload CSV to /shared/incidents/inc-4897.csv when ready.

leah (Marketing): Translation asks: can we get a short localized version for FR/DE/ES? We need translations within 45m for email to EU accounts.

priya (Legal): Approve translations but add legal-safe sentence placeholder: "We have no indication of customer data exposure." to be reviewed by SRE.

tom (SRE): Confirming log scan in progress; will post confirmation in ~10m. No signs of data access in preliminary checks.

deploybot: Incident INC-4897 status updated: state=identified, severity=low. (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4897)

leah (Marketing): Plan recap: 1) Post status page using Variant 2 (reassuring) now. 2) Hold email until rachel uploads CSV and SRE confirms data language. 3) Tweet only after we move to Monitoring. 4) Postmortem + report within 72 hours, and a short FAQ snippet for the email. Any objections?

dan (Growth): +1. Suggest pinning the FAQ to the email so customers get immediate remediation steps.

priya (Legal): +1 pending SRE confirmation line.

rachel (Support): CSV uploaded. File: /shared/incidents/inc-4897.csv. Proceed with targeted email when legal/SRE greenlight.

leah (Marketing): Thanks team 9. I'll post the status update and queue the targeted email once I get the go-ahead. Will ping here when posted.
